title: Ransomware group exploits unpatched VPN zero-day
summary: A ransomware crew used an unpatched remote code execution flaw in an enterprise VPN appliance to gain initial access, then deployed ransomware across the network.

title: Phishing campaign impersonates finance software vendor
summary: Attackers sent business email compromise style phishing messages harvesting credentials from finance teams.

title: Malicious npm package found stealing environment secrets
summary: A popular npm package was compromised in a software supply chain attack, exfiltrating CI environment secrets via a post-install script.

title: Large-scale credential stuffing hits retail login portals
summary: Automated credential stuffing and password spraying attempts targeted retail login portals using leaked credential lists.
